title: When you feel alone
intro: Loneliness is painful, and very common. This practice remembers the sources of support you have, seen and unseen, and sends goodwill outward, which is one way of feeling connected again.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: You are everything to me
steps.text: A prayer of belonging: you are my mother and father, my friend and companion.

steps.title: Who is there
steps.prompt: Who, even one person, could I reach out to this week?

steps.title: Any offering is received
steps.text: Whatever is offered with love, a leaf, a flower, water, is received.

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Send this wish out to everyone, everywhere: may all beings be happy and free.

after: If you feel alone most of the time, please reach out: to a friend, a counsellor, or Tele-MANAS on 14416.
